referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The homepage uses a restrained top navigation above a split opening: positioning and a professional-search control sit in a clean left field while a city view fills the right through broad angled masks and fine geometric strokes. A pale headline index introduces recent firm news. A large editorial portrait and long feature story create a more human chapter, followed by a spacious client quote, a broad outcome statement, and a charcoal footer with social links, phone, offices, and credential marks. Mobile moves the city image above the promise, compresses navigation into a menu, stacks news links, and turns the feature into a portrait followed by readable copy. The design reads through contrast between architecture, editorial text, and restrained red linework. Transfer this pacing and framing only. Do not inherit the firm's identity, people, cases, case outcomes, quotations, marks, wording, or exact graphic shapes.

rules: put the city image before the positioning text
keep search and contact controls visible and touch sized
stack news items with clear date hierarchy
maintain readable feature copy after the portrait

prohibitedPatterns: copying the Robins Kaplan wordmark, exact red slashes, city or partner photographs, quote, news, cases, results, credentials, or trade dress
unverified verdicts, settlement figures, rankings, testimonials, awards, professional identities, or offices
generic card-wall replacement for the editorial sequence

requiredSignatureElements.description: large city or context image framed by deliberate diagonal geometry
compact linked insight index with clear hierarchy
portrait or context-led story paired with a readable editorial column
dark, organized closing area with verified contact and office information

acceptanceChecks: The opening explains the verified professional service in clear high-contrast text and presents a useful discovery action.
The page moves from positioning to timely information, human context, verified proof, and contact without borrowing source case content.
The mobile layout keeps image framing, navigation, article links, and contact details usable without width overflow.
Any legal practice claims, case results, quotations, rankings, awards, office locations, and staff facts are independently verified for the client.
Source imagery, identity, marks, exact words, cases, outcomes, and quotations never enter the client site.

review.scope: official-source match, paired full-page captures, prompt, requester attestation, and rendered visual review
review.notes: Both existing captures show the Robins Kaplan homepage from the geometric hero through its full footer. PNG pixel dimensions were read from their headers: desktop 1536x2963 and mobile 390x3808. The source's desktop hero heading is pale on white; the prompt prohibits repeating that contrast weakness. Original capture date and viewport heights were not embedded in the PNGs; the manifest records standard comparison viewport heights.
